Explanatory Memorandum 
Allianz Global Risks US Insurance Company 
Allianz America Preferred Property Program Endorsement Filing 
 
1 
 
 
Allianz Global Risks US Insurance Company is submitting for your department’s review and approval, a 
form filing of the new endorsement detailed below.  The Cosmetic Damage Exclusion will, at the insured’s 
option, exclude coverage for Cosmetic Damage to roof surfacing, car ports, HVAC units, antennas, dust 
filtration and/or collection units including piping and supply line components, electrical equipment, 
conduits and wiring, ladders, stairs railings, roof top service doors and man cages, roof ventilation 
components, satellite dishes, sky lights, solar panels, or water tanks, caused by the perils of Windstorm 
or Hail. This exclusion applies only to the locations indicated in the Location Schedule shown in the 
endorsement. 
 
Since this is being filed for large multi-million dollar commercial property policies, rated based on multiple 
properties across multiple locations, natural modeled and unmodeled perils, reinsurance costs and other 
variables, use of this form does not result in any direct impact to the overall premium for the policy so 
there are no rates associated with this form filing. 
 
This endorsement is for use with our Corporate Property Program (Allianz America Preferred Property Form.   
We propose an effective date of January 1, 2023.
